rationale: The tape shows a genuine momentum advance (+19% off the prior close, 2.67x relative volume) that has stalled into a ~30bp coil just under the session high with volume drying to almost nothing and no distribution candles — an equilibrium that can resolve either way. With 12 minutes to the close, any entry is effectively an overnight bet on that coil's resolution: longs are buying at 94.8% of the daily range with no visible catalyst, and shorting into held bids with zero sell pressure is fighting the trend. No informational or structural edge justifies paying the spread here.
